Third floor also contains reading room where Faske spends ~one evening a tenday alone, door bolted, wards active. SELTHRANN EILARYA, LIBRARIAN: half-elven female, 87 (appears mid-40s), retired Cormyrean Royal Library after 40-year career, recruited 14 years ago through three layers of intermediaries.
